About LifePharm

LifePharm is a science-backed wellness company committed to improving lives through innovative regenerative health products. Our e-commerce presence is central to how we serve customers and Independent Business Owners (IBOs) around the world. We operate with integrity, purpose, and a passion for building tools that genuinely improve people's lives.


What You'll Do

You will be the primary Shopify developer responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing our storefront. This role sits at the intersection of front-end development and systems integration — you'll work hands-on with code and closely with our backend team to ensure data flows reliably across all connected systems.


Shopify Development

• Build, customize, and maintain Shopify themes using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

• Develop and manage custom Shopify apps and integrations using the Shopify API and GraphQL

• Implement and test new storefront features, landing pages, and product templates

• Optimize site performance, page load speed, and mobile responsiveness

• Maintain and improve the checkout experience and conversion flows


API Integrations & Data Flow

• Collaborate with backend developers to design and implement API integrations between Shopify and external systems (ERP, CRM, fulfillment, etc.)

• Troubleshoot data flow issues — identify root causes across webhooks, REST/GraphQL endpoints, and third-party middleware

• Build and maintain Shopify webhooks and event-driven workflows

• Document integration logic and data schemas for cross-team clarity

• Support monitoring and alerting for integration health and data sync reliability


Collaboration & Process

• Work closely with marketing, operations, and product stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions

• Participate in sprint planning, code reviews, and team retrospectives

• Maintain clean, well-documented code in version-controlled environments (Git)

• Communicate clearly about timelines, blockers, and technical trade-offs


Required

• 3+ years of professional Shopify development experience

• Strong proficiency in Liquid templating, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML

• Hands-on experience with Shopify APIs (REST Admin API, Storefront API, GraphQL)

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate with backend developers on API integrations

• Experience debugging data flow issues between Shopify and external systems (ERPs, CRMs, fulfillment platforms)

• Familiarity with webhooks, event-driven architecture, and async data patterns

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

• Experience with Git and standard version control workflows

• Experience with Shopify Plus and advanced checkout customization

• Experience with platforms such as Klaviyo, Recharge, Gorgias, or similar Shopify integrations

• Based in Romania


Nice to Have


• Familiarity with Node.js or Python for building custom Shopify apps

• Knowledge of e-commerce analytics and conversion optimization

• Experience working in direct sales or multi-level marketing e-commerce environments
